prompt: Kit-runner character anchor: one character, one pose, three-quarter view, standing at the long bench. Bryn Aukett, fifteen, four days in as the newest kit-runner at Sallowquay Boat-yard. Wears an apron with four worn slots stitched into it at the front, each slot sized for a hand; the fourth has a split in the stitching that a good mend has to go around. Carries an empty satchel. No class, no stat sheet, no armour and no weapon on display: what he can do comes from other people's objects, never from a rating. Read: ordinary, competent, slightly out of place at the bench he was apprenticed at. Nothing heroic - he is the newest kit-runner, which is an embarrassment rather than a destiny. Weathered working clothes, tar and brine, muted coastal-industrial palette, same palette as the yard.
